title: CC-MEDIATION: Evaluating Large Language Models for Cross-Cultural Conflict Mediation

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating cross-cultural value conflicts and evaluating the LLM mediator's ability to shift speakers' stances away from ethnocentric perspectives (cultural bias) to ethnorelative ones using DMIS-based metrics like Trajectory AUC and signed Wasserstein-1 distance.

Analyzing the marginal distribution of the models' predicted intervention turns against ground-truth timings to identify a systematic model tendency (bias) to intervene in early turns regardless of the actual dialogue content.
